_comment: VulnHarvest v0.0.1: launchers explicitly select portable, so no config or PostgreSQL is required. Copy to config.json only when needed. Mode priority: CLI > VULNHARVEST_MODE > config > postgres.
_comment_database: Used only with -mode postgres. Create the database first; startup creates/migrates tables, not the database. ARTEX_PG_DSN overrides these fields.
_comment_skill_dir: Empty uses executable-relative skills/. Optional ARTEX_SKILL_DIR or skill_dir overrides preserve compatibility; relative overrides use the current working directory.
_comment_tools: Optional executable paths, e.g. python,node,npm,npx,rg,nmap,curl,shell,chromium,playwright. Detection order is package runtime/bin > valid configured path > captured PATH. Relative tool paths use package root.
